note: Complete capability refactor with retained research, original test migration, full race/vet verification, reproducible generated code, final-source native acceptance, and documented regression/harness diagnoses. Provider mocks and frontend scope are unchanged.

regressions_found_and_fixed.problem: A committed account update could report failure when a subsequent read observed cancellation.
regressions_found_and_fixed.fix: Apply and render the committed identity returned by the capability workflow, without requiring a post-commit read.
regressions_found_and_fixed.coverage: Migrated context-cancellation tests cover profile, status, biography, country, mobile and credential updates.

regressions_found_and_fixed.problem: Changing configured operators did not update the extracted review service.
regressions_found_and_fixed.fix: Synchronize review operator configuration with the coordinator and protect reads/updates.
regressions_found_and_fixed.coverage: Operator revocation and trusted administration regression tests.

regressions_found_and_fixed.problem: Session cleanup could discard transport associations for committed native acknowledgments, including concurrent logout and shared TCP/HTTP sessions.
regressions_found_and_fixed.fix: Transport owns each emitted frame through write completion; the coordinator separately denies deliveries to revoked sessions. Unwritten batch members release their reservations on socket failure.

harness_issues_found.problem: Historical creation limit is 15 characters; two shell fixtures still generated 24-character names. The pre-refactor backend applied the same limit.
harness_issues_found.correction: Isolated harness uses D or R, a space, and a 12-digit timestamp (14 characters), preserving names-with-spaces assertions. Original scripts, Java assertions and JAR remain unchanged.

harness_issues_found.problem: The presence helper checked only the latest global 404 frame. Bob offline followed by Carol offline could make the later Bob check time out despite receipt of both correct frames.
harness_issues_found.correction: The isolated Java helper selects the latest captured 404 for the requested contact ID and still requires presence 99 plus the peer logout marker. Original Java source and publisher JAR remain untouched.
